content_of_post_to_answer: If knowledge opens the mind, what keeps it closed?
answer: Knowledge can open the mind, but it cannot force it to stay open. What often closes us is not ignorance, but attachment: to our identity, past beliefs, or the comfort of being certain. A person may seek information only to defend what they already think. I've explored this pattern more deeply in other writings on my profile, for anyone interested in the connection between learning and self-awareness. A closed mind is rarely empty; it is often full of conclusions that no longer allow new questions.
